en.headline: Hands Percussion brings Taksu gamelan concert to Sha Tin Town Hall this week
en.dek: Malaysia’s Hands Percussion and Indonesia’s Gamelan Yuganada perform Taksu – The Spirit of Gamelan on 6 and 7 November as part of the Asia+ Festival, with the Hong Kong Children’s Choir joining.
body: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department said the fourth Asia+ Festival will present the concert Taksu – The Spirit of Gamelan on 6 and 7 November at the Sha Tin Town Hall Auditorium.

Malaysia’s Hands Percussion will perform with Indonesia’s Gamelan Yuganada. The programme combines Chinese lion dance drums, Malaysian 24 Festive Drums and Balinese gamelan instruments, together with Mak Yong dance and song. The Hong Kong Children’s Choir (Chamber Youth) will also appear, performing a reimagined version of the folk song Jasmine Flower.

Performances begin at 8pm both evenings. Tickets priced from HK$200 to HK$400 are available through URBTIX; some HK$200 seats have restricted sightlines. The concert is also part of the sixth Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Culture and Arts Festival.

zh.headline: 馬來西亞人人人鼓劇場《銅話鼓事》本周沙田大會堂上演
zh.dek: 人人人鼓劇場與印尼甘美蘭樂團於11月6及7日在沙田大會堂演出《銅話鼓事》，香港兒童合唱團亦參與重新譯繹民謠，屬亞藝無疆藝術節節目。
body: 康樂及文化事務署表示，第四屆亞藝無疆藝術節將於11月6及7日在沙田大會堂演奏廳呈獻《銅話鼓事》音樂會。
馬來西亞人人人鼓劇場將與印尼甘美蘭樂團Gamelan Yuganada合作演出。節目融合中國舞獅鼓、馬來西亞二十四節令鼓及峇里甘美蘭樂器，並配以馬來傳統Mak Yong歌舞。香港兒童合唱團（青年室）亦會參與，演出重新譯繹的民謠《茉莉花》。
兩晚演出均於晚上8時開始。門票由200元至400元，可透過城市電腦售票網購票；部分200元座位視線受阻。此音樂會同時是第六屆粵港澳大灣區文化藝術節節目之一。
